info.title: Ajiri API
info.description: Version-one aliases. Existing /api routes remain supported. Private endpoints require owner authentication. Drafting never sends email. Custom response objects not fully typed here are explicitly marked; consult endpoint guides.

get.description: Same owner permissions, validation, throttles and explicit-action requirements as the legacy route. Custom success response is an extensible JSON object; additional fields are not exhaustively typed in this contract.

* `applied` - Applied (your report)
* `interview` - Interview (your report)
* `offer` - Offer (your report)
* `closed` - Closed (your report)
